item.shincolle_kai.combat_ration_3: Combat Ration (Rice Ball XL, Grudge Flavour)
item.shincolle_kai.equip_airplane_20: Abyssal Liberation Land-based Dive Bomber Ace
item.shincolle_kai.equip_machinegun_6: 4-Inch Twin Dual Purpose Gun Mount + CIC
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap0.text0d0:
§cShinkeiseikan§0 is a group of lovely ship girls born from iron and grudge, they live freely in the ocean originally.

But one day, a fleet called §9Kanmusu§0 appeared with horrible weapons and began to attack §cShinkeiseikan§0's habitat without reason.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap0.text0d1:
Because the vandalism, §cShinkeiseikan§0 is facing a serious crisis of survival.

Only one person can lead the ladies out of despair, it is YOU... become an §4Abyssal Admiral§0 and save them from the crisis!
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap0.text1d0:
Exploring the world and collecting four resources: §dGrudge§0, §dAbyssium§0, §dGrudgeful Ammo§0 and §dPolymetal§0 to construct §cShinkeiseikan§0.

§cShinkeiseikan§0 will protect the owner and attack any hostile mobs at a sufficient supply of resources.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap0.text1d1: Now go to collect these lovely ladies!
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap0.title: Introduction
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text0d0: §d§nGrudge§r§0 is the residue after mob death, it is also the energy source for §cShinkeiseikan§0.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text0d1:
Kill mobs to get §d§nGrudge§r§0, you can build a mob farm to stably produce §d§nGrudge§r§0.


Combine 9 §d§nGrudge§r§0 to get 1 §9Grudge Lump§0, and further combine to §9Heavy Grudge Lump§0.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text10d0: Offering the heaviest grudge and diamonds to pray for Abyssal Goddess's protection, §d§nThe Grudge of Abyssal Goddess§r§0 will protect the §cShinkeiseikan§0 from fatal damage and give her the revenge will as deep as abyss.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text10d1: Put §d§nThe Grudge of Abyssal Goddess§r§0 in ship's inventory, it will be consumed when the ship takes fatal damage. The ship will recover to full HP and be immune to damage for a while.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text11d0: §d§nWo-Class Command Scepter§r§0 is the aircraft command equipment for magic girl Wo-Class. However the Abyssal Admiral cannot transform into magic girl, it can only be used to command ships for Abyssal Admiral.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text11d1:
There are 3 command modes, store up to 9 teams and each team 6 ships maximum.

§2Single Mode§0:
Only 1 §3Focus Target§0, command will ONLY apply to the §3Focus Target§0.

§4Group Mode§0:
0~6 §3Focus Target§0, command will ONLY apply to the §3Focus Target§0.

§6Formation Mode§0:
Ship move in specific formation and gain additional effect, command will apply to ALL ships.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text12d0:
The color circle will appear when holding command scepter:

§2GREEN§0:
Ship in §2Single Mode§0.
§3CYAN§0:
Ship is §3Focus Target§0.
§4RED§0:
Ship in §4Group Mode§0.
§6YELLOW§0:
Ship in §6Formation Mode§0.
§7WHITE§0:
Guard target.

§9Left Click§0:
Add ship to the team / Add target to attackable list / Set focus target.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text12d1:
§9Sprint+Left Click§0:
Change formation.
§9Sneak+Left Click§0:
Remove team / Change command mode.
§9Sneak+Sprint+Left Click§0:
Clear team.
§9Right Click§0:
Move and guard / Attack / Sit / Caress.
§9Sprint+Right Click§0:
Guard target.
§9Sneak+Right Click§0:
Open ship's inventory / Formation GUI.
§9List Players:§0
Change to caress mode.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text13d0:
§9Formation§0:
Ships will move in formation at same speed and gain formation buffs, you need 5 or 6 ships in a team to use formation mode.

If a ship is in formation mode, move/guard command in single/group mode will be disabled.

And if a ship exists in different teams, the formation buff will apply to only one team.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text13d1:
§2Line Ahead§0:
Artillery combat formation, increase firepower but lost defence.

§3Double Line§0:
A cruising formation with slight firepower buff.

§4Diamond§0:
Defence formation for aerial combat.

§6Echelon§0:
Charge formation with high moving speed buff.

§7Line Abreast§0:
Defence formation for anti-submarine combat.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text14d0:
§d§nModel 21 Zero Fighter§r§0

Scale: 1/48

Made From: Polymetal

Serving Size: 2500g

Serving Per Container: 1

Shelf Life: §k100§r YR
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text14d1:
This model aircraft complies with Abyssal Edible Toys Standard, it's ZERO CALORIES, FUN and TASTY!

This product contains rich polymetal, helps digestion and absorption of heavy metal, effectively promotes children's growth.




**AVOID SUNSHINE, HIGH TEMPERATURE AND HIGH OXYGEN.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text15d0: The §d§nAbyssal Logbook§r§0 contains detailed information of the abyssal resources, §cShinkeiseikan§0 and §9Kanmusu§0 found so far.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text16d0: The §d§nAbyssal Portable Radar§r§0 can detect nearby owned ships and remotely contact them or give orders.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text17d0:
This stable and durable §d§nAbyssal Admiral's Desk§r§0 is made of obsidian. In addition to deal with the official business, it can also block the gunfire from angry secretary ship.
**Please ask the secretary ship before purchasing the furniture.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text17d1:
§9Radar§0:
Show a list of nearby owned ships, click ship on the list to carry out other action.

§9Abyssal Logbook§0:
Items, blocks and ships introduction.

§9Faction§0:
Create or add team with PVP mode.

§9Target List§0:
Browse attack target list.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text18d0:
§9Right Click:§0 Change Abyssal Waypoint stay time.

§9Sneak + Right Click:§0 pairing Abyssal Waypoint / Abyssal Crane and Chest.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text19d0:
When the lava is compressed by heavy grudge, it will become §d§nAbyssal Volcano Block§r§0.

Decorative block.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text1d0: §d§nAbyssium§r§0 is a metal enchanted by grudge. It's the main material to build §cShinkeiseikan§0 and equipments.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text1d1: Combine 1 Grudge and 1 Iron Ingot to get 1 §d§nAbyssium§r§0, 9 ingots can be combined to 1 §9Abyssium Block§0.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text20d0:
When the lava is compressed by Abyssal Volcano Block, it will become §d§nAbyssal Volcano Core§r§0.

The core will consume grudge and spread the energy into the environment.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text20d1:
To active the core, place it §9nearby any liquid block and put some grudge§0.

§dEffect Area: width 13 / height 13 (down 6 / up 6) blocks§0.

If a ship is in liquid block within the effect area, she will restore HP and morale value.

The energy is said to maintain skin and beauty, it's very popular among the Shinkeiseikan.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text21d0:
Twisted abyssal frame, decorative block.

It's a ladder block.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text22d0:
Waypoint block, player can link waypoints by §dTarget Wrench§0.

If a ship moves to a waypoint, the ship will continue move to next waypoint.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text22d1:
§9Right Click§0 with §dTarget Wrench§0 to show the waypoint info.
§9Sneak + Right Click§0 to link two waypoints.

A waypoint can save 1 NEXT and 1 LAST waypoint, and the max distance is 48 blocks.

If a waypoint links back to it's last waypoint (next = last), when the ship moves to the waypoint, the ship will begin to move backwards.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text23d0: The machine block for loading and unloading items to ship. Owner can link the §dAbyssal Crane§0 to §9any chest§0 or other §9Abyssal Waypoint§0 by §dTarget Wrench§0. Ship will start to load/unload items when she gets to the crane and go to the next waypoint after the job done.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text23d1:
§9Top Left§0 button is §9Power Switch§0.

§9The Top Largest§0 button is §9Waiting Mode§0.

§9Middle§0 buttons with M/D/N are item matching condition.

§9Center 9x2 Slots§0 are loading/unloading target, left all empty means §9ANY§0 item.

Loading/Unloading can disable separately, and ship will not attack and move while craning.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text24d0:
§9Right click§0 this book on ship will increase the ship level 5 ~ 10.

This book can be found in dungeon chest too.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text25d0:
A fluid container for ship fluid transport. There are 4 sizes of fluid container.
Ship have to equip at least one §9Abyssal Pumps Station§0 to transfer fluid to the containers in the ship's inventory at Abyssal Crane.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text26d0:
§9Right click§0 to set recipe for ship's crafting task.

Please see chap.3 for more details.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text27d0:
§9Numpad 1:§0
§6ADD§r or §cREMOVE§0 entity in §dUnattackable Target List§0. §4(OP ONLY!!)§0

§9Numpad 2:§0
Show §dUnattackable Target List§0.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text27d1:
§dUnattackable Target§0 immune to all ship's attack, and can't be targeted. You can add entity like leash knot, item frame, cart or boat.

This list applies to hostile mob ships too.

Ship, hostile ship and ship's summons can't be unattackable target.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text28d0:
§9Enchant Shell§0 can be made in §cHadal Hydrothermal Vortex§0, and then craft with 8x the same potions to gain the potion effect.

Further, crafting with 8x the same potions can increase the effect chance and duration.

Crafting with different potions will replace the potion effect.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text2d0: §d§nPolymetal§r§0 mainly spawned in the water type biomes (ocean, river, beach). It's the main material to build §cShinkeiseikan§0 and equipments.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text2d1:
This crunchy metal ball is one of aircraft carrier's favorite snack.

You can find lots §d§nPolymetallic Gravel§r§0 on the seabed.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text3d1:
In addition to iron, you can also use copper, gold and diamond to make different quantity of ammo.

Replace §9Gunpowder§0 with §9Blazepowder§0 to make heavy ammo.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text4d0: §d§nRepair Bucket§r§0 is made from the most nutritious lava of the ocean and seasoned with grudge, it's the most popular §cShinkeiseikan§0 drinks.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text4d1:
Right click on ship to repair the ship.

Ships can automatically use the §d§nRepair Bucket§r§0 in their inventory.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text5d0:
§d§nShinkeiseikan Wedding Ring§r

With the classic minimalist style of prong mount and Nether Star Cut, it generously showcase the light of Nether Star.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text5d1:
It symbolizes the beauty of Nether and the owner's strength, and it's also the important sign of lasting love.

§9Sneaking+Right Click§0:
Marry the ship.
§9Right Click§0:
Activate the ring.

The number of married will activate different abilities: digging speed, vision, breathing, mobility in liquid and immune to fire.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text6d0: The §d§nShinkeiseikan Ownership Paper§r§0 describes the contents of the various items in detail with the transfer of ownership the two sides should fulfill, just to take effect after signature of the parties.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text6d1:
§9Right Click§0:
Sign the paper.

After the signature of the parties, the owner can sneaking + right click the paper on the ship to transfer the ownership to other player.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text7d0: §d§nDismantle Hammer§r§0 can decompose the ship and recycle some of the material.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text7d1:
§9Left Click§0:
One shot kill the ship. (OWNER/OP ONLY)

§9Sneaking + Right Click§0:
Decompose the ship. (OWNER/OP ONLY)
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text8d0: §d§nModernization Toolkit§r§0 contains a variety of the latest abyssal black technology, can be used to upgrade the ship's attributes.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text8d1:
§9Right Click§0 on ship to upgrade one of the ship's attributes randomly. The level of attributes is represented by color in ship's inventory GUI:

§fWHITE§0 (Lv1)
§eYELLOW§0 (Lv2)
§6ORANGE§0 (Lv3)
§4RED§0 (Lv4)

The maximum level is §4RED§0 (Lv4).
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text9d0: §d§nInstant Construction Material§r§0 contains some rare materials and the welding gun which provides a temperature higher than geocentric, it can improve the construction speed of abyssal ships and equipments.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.text9d1:
Put the §d§nInstant Construction Material§r§0 in §9Abyssal Hydrothermal Vent§0 or §9Hadal Hydrothermal Vortex§0 to increase the construction progress.

§d§nInstant Construction Material§r§0 can only be crafted from NOT USED ship construction item.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap1.title: Resources
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap2.text0d0: You can start building primary class §cShinkeiseikan§0 in the §9Abyssal Hydrothermal Vent§0 if you have collected enough resources.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap2.text0d1: You need §916~64§0 §4Grudge / Abyssium Ingot / Polymetallic Nodules / Grudgeful Ammo§0 and a large amount of lava as power.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap2.text1d0:
After putting resources into the §9Abyssal Hydrothermal Vent§0, click the §4"Ship Spawn Egg"§0 icon on the right side to start building §cShinkeiseikan§0.

§9Double Click§0 the icon to enter a §cContinuously Build Mode§0, the amounts of four resources will be recorded and every construction will consume the recorded resources.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap2.text1d1:
You can get a §9Ship Spawn Egg§0 when construction is completed, use the egg to create a random §cShinkeiseikan§0.

The spawn egg user will become the §cShinkeiseikan§0's owner.

The amounts of four resources will affect the kind of §cShinkeiseikan§0, ex: §dPolymetal§0 will §9increase§0 the prob of §dAircraft Carrier§0.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap2.text2d0:
In general, the more materials consumed, the better Shinkeiseikan you get.

To §9Develop Equipments§0, click the §4"Cannon"§0 icon, the construction condition is same with ship building.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap2.text2d1:
§cTips:§0

1. Put §9Instant Construction Material§0 into fuel slot to speed up build progress.

2. Put §9EnderTank§4 (mod: EnderStorage)§0 into fuel slot to refuel lava.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap2.text3d0: When you have accumulated a lot of resources, you can try to build advanced class §cShinkeiseikan§0 in §9Hadal Hydrothermal Vortex§0.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap2.text3d1:
§9Hadal Hydrothermal Vortex§0 is a 3x3x3 multiblock building:

§cBottom Layer:§3 3x3 Polymetallic Block§0

§cMiddle Layer: §34 corners of Polymetallic Block§0

§cTop Layer: §3Heavy Grudge Lump§0

§9Right click§0 the §4Heavy Grudge Lump§0 to activate the vortex.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap2.text4d0:
§9To construct advanced §cShinkeiseikan§0:

1. Put resources into the 9 slots.

2. Click 4 resources icon and adjust the value by arrows.

3. Click §4"Ship Spawn Egg"§0 icon to start construction.

4. §9Double Click§0 to enter §4Continuously Build Mode§0.

NOTE: The leftmost slot cannot be extracted by hopper or pipe, and other slots can only be extracted when the red arrow is in §9Release§0 mode.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap2.text4d1:
Click the §4Red Arrow§0 to change resources mode: §9Release§0 or §9Suck In§0.

The large construction requires §9100~1000§0 each resources and lots of lava to process.

And the more materials consumed, the better §cShinkeiseikan§0 you get.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap2.text5d0: The equip development is same with ship construction, put some materials in the §9Abyssal Hydrothermal Vent§0 or §9Hadal Hydrothermal Vortex§0 and click the Equip button to develop equips.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap2.text5d1:
The equip info is decribed in the item tooltip:

Factor Mats:
The number represents the total amount of materials and the effective material.

Rare Level:
Higher the value means the more rare in that equip type.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap2.text6d0:
Equips can be enchanted by enchanted book and anvil to increase the stats. Enchanting costs fixed 30 levels. There are 3 enchant types: §cWeapon§0, §9Armor§0 and §3Misc§0, some enchantment only works on specific type.

§9Protection:§0 +HP.
§9Sharpness, Smite, Bane, Power:§0 +damage, §cWEAPON§0 only.
§9Unbreaking:§0 +DEF, §3ARMOR§0 only.
§9Efficiency:§0 +reload speed.
§9Aqua Affinity, Feather Fall, Depth Strider:§0 +move speed.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap2.text6d1:
§9Knockback, Punch:§0 +range.
§9Frost Walker:§0 +critical.
§9Fire, Flame:§0 +double/triple hit.
§9Lure:§0 +miss reduction.
§9Thorns:§0 +AA.
§9Respiration:§0 +ASM.
§9Looting, Fortune, Luck:§0 +exp gain, §cWEAPON§0 only.
§9Silk Touch:§0 +grudge gain, §3NON-WEAPON§0 only.
§9Infinity:§0 +ammo gain, §cWEAPON§0 only.
§9Mending:§0 +HP recovery, §3NON-WEAPON§0 only.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap2.title: Construction
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap3.text0d0:
§91.§0 By construction.

§92.§0 Found in dungeon chest.

§93.§0 Defeating the spawned hostile ship.


The easiest way is spending resources to build ship, and you can find some advanced class ship and equipment in dungeon chest.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap3.text0d1:
If you have §dShinkeiseikan Wedding Ring§0 in inventory and in the §9Sea/Beach§0 biome, the hostile fleet may appear on the sea.

You can get a ship's spawn egg by defeating the spawned hostile ship.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap3.text10d0:
There are restraint relations between ships, check: §9https://goo.gl/jmR3Wd§0

§9Destroyer (DD):§c HIGH speed / LOW HP§0, against SS and Aircraft.
§9Cruiser:§0 Including heavy cruiser (CA), light cruiser (CL) and torpedo cruiser (CLT), average attributes.
§9Aircraft Carrier (CV): §cLONGEST attack range§0, against all ships except SS.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap3.text10d1:
§9Aviation Battleship (BBV):§0 Including BBV and Installation, attributes range between CV and BB. §dInstallation§0 has §cLOW firepower / HIGH HP§0.
§9Battleship (BB):§c LOW speed / HIGH HP and firepower§0, against all ship but SS and Aircraft.
§9Submarine (SS):§c LOW speed and HP / HIGH firepower§0, against all ship but Aircraft.
§9Aircraft:§0 Aircraft attack by CV and BBV, against all ship but SS.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap3.text11d0:
Some shinkeiseikan can summon mounts, it can be enabled in §9Appearance§0 page in §9AI Options§0.

§9Right-click§0 on a mount to ride it, then owner can control mount movement and use attack skills.

§9Press move key§0 (default:WASD) and §9jump key§0 (default:SPACE) to control movement.

§9Press hotbar key 1~4§0 (default:1,2,3,4) to use attack skills.
Attack skills consume ship's ammo and grudge, and the cooldown time is counted separately from ship's attack skills.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap3.text12d0:
Status effect can increase or decrease ship's attributes.

§9Speed:§0 +move speed
§cSlowness:§0 -move speed
§9Haste:§0 +attack speed
§cMining Fatigue:§0 -attack speed
§9Strength:§0 +damage
§cWeak:§0 -damage
§9Absorption:§0 +defence and HP
§cPoison:§0 -defence
§9Health Boost:§0 +HP and HP regen
§9Resistance:§0 -damage by torpedo
§9Fire-Resistance:§0 -damage by non-torpedo
§9Jump Boost:§0 +hit range
§cBlind:§0 -hit range greatly
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap3.text12d1:
§cInstant Damage:§0 damage ship
§9Instant Heal:§0 heal ship
§cWither:§0 damage ship over time
§9Regeneration:§0 heal ship over time
§cNausea:§0 +miss rate greatly
§9Night Vision:§0 -80%% damage reduce effect in night
§9Luck:§0 +critical/double/triple hit rate
§cBad Luck:§0 -critical/double/triple hit rate
§9Water Breathing:§0 +ASM and dodge rate
§9Levitation: +AA and dodge rate§0
Hunger: +grudge consumption greatly
§9Saturation:§0 increase grudge and ammo gained, heal HP and increase morale over time
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap3.text13d0:
The morale level will affect ship's attributes and experience gain.

There are 5 level of morale: §dExcited§0, §cHappy§0, §2Normal§0, §9Tired§0, §7Exhausted§0.

The morale level is marked in the upper right corner of ship's inventory GUI.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap3.text13d1:
§9Idle:§0
Recover morale to §2NORMAL§0 state, out of combat faster than in combat.

§9Caress, Kill:§0
Increase morale to §dEXCITED§0 state.

§9Feeding:§0
Increase to §cHAPPY§0 state.

§9Moving, Attack, Damaged:§0
Decrease morale.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap3.text14d0:
Generally the ship don't need to feed, but you can feed ship to increase morale and grudge value manually.

§9Right click§0 on ship with food or some items to feed the ship.

You can only feed a certain times in a period of time.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap3.text14d1:
§9Grudge, Food:§0
Increase grudge, morale value.

§9Ammo:§0
Increase morale and ammo value a little more than automatically consumed by ship.

§9Abyssium, Polymetal:§0
Increase number of aircraft for CV.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap3.text15d0:
The owner can caress ship to reward or simply harass her. A correct caress can §9improve the shop's morale§0 effectively.

To caress ship, hold §dWo-Class Command Scepter§0 and press §9List Players (default: TAB)§0 to change to caress mode, and §9Right Click§0 on the ship.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap3.text15d1:
Caress target is determined by the cross and the relative face angle between owner and ship.

The target are: top, head, face, neck, chest, belly, under belly, leg, arm, back.

Different individuals have different sensitive part, be careful of the reaction when caressing.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap3.text16d0:
Ship can help the owner to cook item:

§91.§0 Click the raw beef icon in AI options
§92.§0 Put the item to be cooked to mainhand slot (the most middle and lower slot in the first page)
§93.§0 Put the fuel item to offhand slot. (option)
§94.§0 Check metadata/forge ore dict/nbt tag in the same AI page. (option)
§95.§0 Move ship to an Abyssal Waypoint.
§96.§0 Link the waypoint and a furnace block by Target Wrench.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap3.text16d1:
§97.§0 Set the input/output/fuel side of the furnace in AI option. (B:Bottom T:Top N:North S:South W:West E:East)
§98.§0 Ship will start cooking the target item except main/offhand slot.

Cooking is a difficult job, less experienced ship sometimes produce some dark matter in cooking.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap3.text17d0:
Ship can go fishing to feed the owner:

§91.§0 Click the fishing rod icon in AI options.
§92.§0 Put the fishing rod to mainhand slot.
§93.§0 Move the ship to the pool with depth >= 3 blocks.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap3.text17d1: §9"Luck of the Sea"§0 enchantment on the fishing rod and luck potion can increase the rate of rare drop from fishing.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap3.text18d0:
Ship can go mining to feed the lazy owner:

§91.§0 Click the pickaxe icon in AI options.
§92.§0 Put the pickaxe to mainhand slot.
§93.§0 Move the ship to the mine with a lot of solid blocks.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap3.text18d1:
Ship can get ores without breaking blocks.

§92.§0 Click the crafting icon in AI options.

§911. Onsight?§0: Only attack target on sight.

§9Priority§0: §dAnti-Air§0 > §3Anti-SS§0 > §cPVP§0 > Other

gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap3.text8d1: §916. Auto Pump§0: Ship can pump liquid by Abyssal Pumps Station (equip) to Abyssal Fluid Drum. If ship get some glass bottles, she can collect xp orbs too.

§91.§0 Enable PVP Mode by §cCreating a Fleet§0 in §3Abyssal Admiral's Desk§0.

§92.§0 Default PVP state is §7Neutral§0 to other fleets.

§93.§0 You can §cAlly/Declare War§0 against other fleets in §3Abyssal Admiral's Desk§0.

§94.§0 Ship will attack other hostile fleets by enabling §cPVP Mode§0 in AI option.

§95.§0 If §cFriendlyFire§0 = §3false§0, AoE attack will not damage to allies.
gui.shincolle_kai.book.chap3.text9d1:
§96. §cAlly§0 is §3UNILATERAL§0, other side can still be hostile, friendly or neutral.

§97. §cDeclaration of War§0 is §3BILATERAL§0, other side will be hostile too.

§98.§0 Other side will become neutral to you when §cBreaking Alliance§0.

§99.§0 Other side will keep hostile when §cCalling a Truce§0.

§910.§0 You can not declare war against the fleet in the ally list, vice versa.
